entities.summary: Atanas Golomeev was a Bulgarian professional basketball player and coach. At a height of 2.08 m tall, he played at the center position. He is the most decorated Bulgarian basketball player of all time. He was named one of FIBA's 50 Greatest Players, in 1991. In 2019, he was inducted into the FIBA Hall of Fame.
